boundaries.why_not_directly_proved: Managed Vault admission, revision/lifecycle selectors, the owner/namespace admission predicate, and durable stale-transition rejection are implementation-checked, while bounded TLA+ models check original-epoch Managed pair publication, abort-only expired-Writing takeover, unreachable late-write orphan isolation, one-target rollout, exact event-id collision handling, and root-delete crash/retry protocols. The Kani namespace harness does not prove UUID entropy, string uniqueness, or SecretStore conditional effects. Rust-to-model refinement, database and SecretStore durability, database-authoritative renewable lease time, Session-idle and supervisor fairness, fleet-wide consumer discovery, provider-side revocation propagation, cryptographic implementations, and eventual fleet convergence remain external. A delayed fenced write is isolated only when physical namespaces are distinct and can become only an unreachable orphan that generic inventory reports but deliberately retains without a durable atomic claim.
boundaries.architecture_change: Add database-authoritative renewable leases, a durable orphan-claim protocol, and generation-aware conditional SecretStore put/delete receipts; use a durable consumer/adoption registry, signed versioned provider revocation facts, linear expiring materialization permits, checked backend histories, monitored rollout lag, and deployment-specific convergence controllers at the remaining external boundary.
boundaries.target_formal_method: Kani publication/permit selectors plus Rust trace refinement, fault-injection, adapter conformance and rollout-lag SLO evidence
boundaries.acceptance_gate: Every Managed lifecycle command publishes its exact Source/child pair or leaves both unchanged; an expired Writing claim reaches only durable abort cleanup, while material Put, MarkReady, and pair publication remain original epoch-1 transitions; stale attempts cannot overwrite a later attempt when the backend honors exact physical namespaces; unreferenced material is reported and is deleted only after a durable exact orphan claim; root completion requires every modeled child tombstone and configured-target rollout acknowledgement; materialization requires a live exact fact and unspent permit; externally observed revocation and fleet adoption meet their declared SLOs.
